title: aspidium truncatulum
intro: Aspidium truncatulum, commonly known as the Autumn fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and fight against infections. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium truncatulum include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
